title: Log-Sum-Exp
signature: def logsumexp(x: np.ndarray, axis: int = -1) -> np.ndarray
hints: log(sum(exp(x))) equals c + log(sum(exp(x - c))) for any constant c.
Pick c = max(x) along the axis. The largest term becomes exp(0) = 1, so the sum is at least 1 and its log is finite.
Take the max with keepdims=True so it broadcasts against x, then drop that axis from the result.
